title: Parliament of India debate search: Lok Sabha (elibrary.sansad.in text search and sansad.in text-of-debates) and Rajya Sabha (rsdoc.nic.in verbatim PDFs), "wealth tax" and related terms, 2010-2026
notes: Crawled all Rajya Sabha sitting days from 2010 (1,191 days, full-day verbatim PDFs via rsdoc.nic.in) and all Lok Sabha sitting days from the 15th Lok Sabha (1,085 days via sansad.in api_ls) for wealth tax, inheritance tax, estate duty and related phrases (English), plus Devanagari terms in the Lok Sabha. About 200 raw hits were read in context; 24 speeches were recorded as rows (two speakers are dead and excluded). Estate-duty-only and opposing speeches were not recorded. Hindi text in Rajya Sabha PDFs uses a broken font and Lok Sabha Hindi is partly garbled, so Hindi-language speeches are not covered.
